# Micah Prentice

> Operator and builder. Runs two holiday-lighting businesses out of Florida and is building Prism, an operating system for trade service businesses. Founder, Prism · Operator · Investor.

Everything below is taken from the pages on micahprentice.com.

## About

- Micah Prentice runs home-service businesses in Florida and is building Prism, an operating system for trade service companies.
- Thesis: the best software for the trades gets built by people who have run the crews.
- 10+ years building. Two service brands. One OS to run them.
- Ikigai: what he loves (building, solving problems, competing), what he is good at (strategy, sales, operations, negotiating), what the world needs (better systems, smarter decisions), what he is paid for (software, service, ownership).

## Ventures

- [Prism](https://getprismpro.com): The OS for trade service businesses. Quote, schedule, dispatch, and get paid from one place; desktop in the office, phone in the truck. Private beta, onboarding shops now. Holiday lighting is the cash flow and the live test bed; everything Prism ships runs on his own trucks first. Investors can request the deck at https://prism-investor.com.
- [Ugly Sweater Holiday Lighting](https://uglysweaterlights.com): Holiday-lighting brand. Real crews, real seasons, real revenue.
- [Christmas Lighting KY](https://christmaslightingky.com): Holiday-lighting brand.
- [Quantec Power](https://quantecpower.com): Power and energy venture. An early bet, still running. Status: live.
- [Speeedbiz](https://speeedbiz.com): Research an industry, validate an idea, find the path to first dollar. A long-term bet, not active yet.
- The Build Podcast: on the bench.

## Pages

- [Home](https://micahprentice.com/): Who Micah is, what he is building, the incubator, his bookshelf, and how to get in touch.
- [Custom event software](https://micahprentice.com/events): Branded registration, RSVP, check-in, attendee portals, and follow-up for corporate events. Built to your brand in days, owned by you, no per-registrant licensing. Fixed quotes after a 30-minute call; no per-head fees.
- [Homventory](https://micahprentice.com/homventory): Free tool that turns listing photos into a tap-to-decide inventory of what conveys with a home.
